built.the index: Incremental, per source, keyed by (sha256, extractor hash). source_rows(key, pages) is a pure function: each page cut into places with places.split, each place with its doorway line numbers (first, last; blank lines not numbered), its lines, label, page and pack, and its terms. Rows are stored once per key (table library_places, with a digest) and bound to every admitted, current item with that key (table library_bound). sync() unbinds changed or gone items, cuts a new key once, keeps an unchanged key's rows, and drops keys no item holds. A source whose stored segment text fails its text_sha256 is left out. Admitted and current means references.current accepts it (bytes, decision, extractor hash). The index is a rebuildable cache beside the reference index, never a record. MemoryStore and DbStore share sync(), so the differential check exercises the same code the Kernel runs.
built.places: search() ranks the index's places with places.score, 0.8.6's one rule, now shared by places.rank. Up to 8 places by default, 12 at most, each as file, page, lit line (the place's line carrying most matched words), why it matched ('your words: landlord; for the shape of your question: within, after') and places.said's line. No model.
built.ASK turn: Registered with turns.py: switch 'reading', Caps(new_tokens 1000, answer 48, deadline 6 s), paper PAGES. Message 1 is a fixed brief (point only, the page is data). Message 2 is doorway.page_message, with flagged lines withheld. Message 4 is the question in the owner's words, plus the value kind its shape wants. The grammar is grammars.ask_lines over the page's open line numbers and its own words (at most 40 characters a word, 2,500 distinct words), up to 3 'L<n> | <words>' or NONE. The parser refuses an out-of-shape row alone and refuses free text whole. The check, per line, in order: on the asked page (else LINE_NOT_ON_THE_PAGE); not withheld (LINE_FLAGGED); the words verbatim on that line (page_marks.find_verbatim) and outside a secret span (VALUE_NOT_ON_LINE); on a flagged page, no word found only in withheld lines (USES_WITHHELD_WORDS); the value kind the question's shape wants, using page_marks' own rules: 'how long' needs a period with a time unit (PERIOD_WITHOUT_A_TIME_UNIT), 'when' a date or a period, 'how much' an amount or a number with its unit; duplicates are dropped. The desk then cuts the quote itself: the whole place the line stands in, its mark taken as its label, joined with single spaces, with the offsets of the lit words. Verdicts are TAKEN, TRIMMED or REFUSED, and NONE is TAKEN with no line. The fallback is PLACES.
built.ask(): The fixed 'should I' decline comes first, using reading.SHOULD, MEDICAL, LEGAL and CLAIM and reading.WORDS, before any model; the places of the rest of the question are still listed, read only. With no places: 'Nothing on your admitted pages carries these words.' Otherwise the places are grouped by page in rank order, and each page is resolved as admitted now (references.resolve, checked against the original), passed through the doorway and asked once. A page whose every line is withheld, or that is unavailable, is passed over and said so. If the model points, the desk's cut quote is said ('§ 12(a), page 1: “Within 21 days …”'), then 'The model pointed at line 10 of that page; the desk found “21 days” on it and cut the quote itself.', with the CHECKED mark. NONE moves to the next page. When every page asked says NONE: 'The 8 places I looked at do not say.', 'These are the places I looked at:' and the list. If the request's ceiling of 3 turns stops her: 'I did not ask about the other N: this request has had its turns.' No model, a switch off, a late or refused answer: the places stand, 'lit by the desk', with the reason in words. Every answer to a legal question, or with a place on a legal page, ends with mind_words.FOOTER. Her templates only say what the text says, never what it means for the owner, and they pass mind_words.check.

decisions: ASK caps: new_tokens 1000 rather than the table's 60. The page is message 2 and is not kept from a MARKS turn, because the brief differs and so the prefix differs. With 60, an ASK on a page the worker has not just read would always be OVER_CAP and never sent. The deadline cap stays at the design's 6 s, so on the 4B here a page's first ASK may be LATE, and then the places stand. That is for the model check to measure.

Turns are per page, not per place: one ASK covers every listed place on its page, and NONE moves to the next page. The request's ceiling of 3 foreground turns bounds how many pages are asked. When it stops her, she says how many places were not asked.
'Lit by cue words' with no model means each place's line carrying most of the question's matched words, plus 'why it matched' in words.

Value kinds by the question's shape (a fixed, short table, EXPECT): how long gives a period; when gives a date or a period; how much gives an amount or a number with its unit. A question of no listed shape takes the words as words.

The index refreshes lazily inside library.search and library.ask. That is a write to rebuildable cache tables inside read-scope operations, the same class of thing as the FTS index and the doorway flag cache, never a record. Each refresh checks every indexed source with references.current, which reads and hashes the originals. That is fine for Home Demo (37 ms) and is the price of 'admitted and current'.
library_service calls page_marks._rule and page_marks._resolve, both lane C's own, to reuse the value rules and the resolver rather than copy them.
decline() reuses reading's patterns and words and repeats only reading._decline's three-way choice of words, because _decline needs reading's lexicon.
